integrity: The self-contained C++17 and Python standard-library programs reproduce the complete finite counts and distances; known four-colouring count is prior knowledge, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Finite critical four-colour reconfiguration classification for one 11-vertex graph, not an infinite-family or five-colour metric theorem. Exact priority not certified; July 2005 relevant report has month-only public date evidence. All finite distance claims supplied with two runnable enumerators; no independent scholarly audit performed.
title: Critical-palette recolouring of the Grötzsch graph: two components and sixty diametral pairs
